browser.environment: Actual React components, synthetic authentication/API/streaming/proposal fixtures; no account/database/model connections

limitations: Live provider latency/billing and hosted proxy buffering were not tested; paid provider calls were prohibited.
Tool-enabled turns, Planner structured proposals, and non-GPT-OSS custom Groq models stay buffered.
Visual verification is a component fixture, not a deployed authenticated end-to-end release or real-device test.
Stopped or disconnected partial replies can be unsaved; refresh reconciles persisted history and no automatic resend occurs.
Image capture and speech transcription are prepared extension boundaries, not enabled features.
Broader test failures and legacy lint debt above remain outside this phase.
